'''Hrthging''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in the [[Hrthging system/Legends|Hrthging system]] of [[Mandalore sector/Legends|Mandalore sector]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]]. It was home to the [[Hrthgingian Firegem]]. It became part of [[Mandalore sector/Legends|Mandalorian Space]].
